title: docs(qa): qa-scratch-authz declares the qa namespace its object names carry
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8PDySTeSiKA9H6WzqZcUmrp)_
Fixes #26791

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`areas/attachments-storage.json` 的配方 `qa-scratch-authz` 第 1 步安装清单声明 `namespace: "qa"`;用到该配方的三个条目 revision 各升一级(7、9、9)并加一行 history。
- 为什么改:实测照原文重放,安装把命名空间推成 `attachments`,第 2–4 步建对象全部 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX,三个条目的鉴权子句只能记 blocked(fixture)。
- 风险与回滚:只改 QA 台账一个 JSON 文件,不动产品代码;对象名不变,其余步骤与条目子句一字未动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json` 顶部配方的 step 1 与 provenance,再看三个条目 history 的最新一行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,预期 OK。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `qa-scratch-authz` step 1 (`POST /api/v1/packages`) now declares `manifest.namespace: "qa"`. Its `expect` says why the namespace is declared and that it must be unique on the boot; its `source` cites the namespace derivation and the prefix judge.
- The recipe's `provenance` records the replay below.
- The three items that opt into the recipe each take a revision and a `history` row citing #26791: `download-authz-both-sides` (6 → 7), `read-inherits-parent-rls` (8 → 9) and `attach-requires-parent-edit` (8 → 9). No step or clause sentence changed in any of them.

## Why

Read on main 8eef9a8d. Every object a package defines must be named `NS_SHORT`; the direct save asks `objectNamespacePrefixViolation` (ADR-0129 D2) against the namespace the package declares. A manifest that declares none gets one derived from its id's last segment at install (`protocol-package-install.ts`, `deriveNamespaceFromPackageId`), so `com.objectstack.qa.attachments` became `attachments`, and `qa_vault` / `qa_shared` / `qa_nofiles` were refused.

The card allowed two fixes: rename the three objects, or declare a namespace their names already carry. Declaring `qa` changes one line. A rename would touch about 40 mentions across the recipe, step 6's three permission-set bodies and the three items, so the declared namespace was chosen.

## Tests

No code changed. The recipe was replayed REST only on two fresh stock showcase boots built from 8eef9a8d (`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT`, no env posture), with the recipe JSON read from the file and sent literally.

<details><summary>Before: the recipe as it stood on main</summary>

```text
step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "attachments" (derived)
step 2 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_vault?package=com.objectstack.qa.attachments -> 422
   {"error":"Object 'qa_vault' is missing the package namespace prefix. Rename it to 'attachments_qa_vault' (namespace = 'attachments').","code":"NAMESPACE_PREFIX"}
step 3 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_shared?package=... -> 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX (attachments_qa_shared)
step 4 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_nofiles?package=... -> 422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX (attachments_qa_nofiles)
GET /api/v1/meta/object/qa_vault | qa_shared | qa_nofiles -> 404 each
```

</details>

<details><summary>After: the recipe as this PR writes it</summary>

```text
step 1 POST /api/v1/packages -> 201   manifest.namespace "qa"
step 2 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_vault?package=com.objectstack.qa.attachments -> 200   state active
step 3 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_shared?package=... -> 200   state active
step 4 PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_nofiles?package=... -> 200   state active
step 6 PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/qa_att_reader|qa_att_baseline|qa_att_editor?package=... -> 200 each
   (reader and editor carry the security-private-no-readscope advisory the step expects)
GET /api/v1/meta/object/qa_vault | qa_shared | qa_nofiles -> 200 each
teardown DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.objectstack.qa.attachments -> 200   deletedCount 6 (three objects, three sets)
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The same refusal hits two sibling recipes this card does not own, measured on the same boot: `qa-media-constraints` in this file (`qa_media` under `com.objectstack.qa.media`, derived namespace `media`) and `qa-feeds-disabled` in `areas/records-forms.json` (`qa_nofeeds` under `com.objectstack.qa.feeds`, derived `feeds`). Both answer 422 `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` at their object save. They are reported to the seat, not fixed here. Their fix must not declare `qa` too, or installing both on one boot answers `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`.
